name: Star Fox: Event Horizon
summary:
Star Fox: Event Horizon is a stand-alone Star Fox fan game built on the FreeSpace 2 Open engine, featuring three playable campaigns as of 2026 - one set during the Second Lylat War from the story of Star Fox 64, one based on the world of Star Fox Adventures and a third fully original campaign, "The Talan Incident".

The game also features voice actors Estelle Ellis and the late Frank "Jock" Blaney reprising their roles as Krystal and Wolf respectively.
